title: Unknown to Officers, They Had a Gun
description:
On July 5th, 2022, a patrolling officer observed a Silver Kia travelling at a high rate of speed without a licence plate. As the officer approached the vehicle to attempt a traffic stop, it began to swerve and almost struck a parked vehicle after which the car came to a stop. The backseat passenger was acting erratic and handed the officer a receipt for a firearm. He then showed the gun which was tucked in the pouch in front of his seat. Upon exiting the vehicle, a .45 round fell from the male's possession. The firearm was secured from the seat pouch and after detaining the male, the officers determined that the vehicle was unregistered and proceeded to interrogate the driver. The female driver was very uncooperative. She called the officers "Cracker" and continued to resist while she was being arrested. The officers then informed the male of his charges and proceeded to arrest him too. The officers finally learned of the real relationship between the occupants after the third passenger revealed it to them. The officers finally learned of the real relationship between the occupants after the third passenger, who had been quiet this whole time, revealed it to them. The 20-year-old female was charged with resisting arrest and driving an unregistered vehicle while the male was charged with carrying a concealed weapon. The officers also called an uber for the third passenger who was innocent. Youtube thinks you’ll love the video on screen, click to watch now.

About Us / Disclaimer: 

Police Insider provides unbiased and authentic footage of incidents captured on body cams. We believe this footage can be used as an educational guide for viewers. 

We only provide unique and original content that hasn’t been covered before on YouTube.

The raw footage for the videos on this channel have been obtained directly from the respective Police Departments. We as a media company have the right to use it commercially. Most incidents may require a fee associated with the request and take several days to process.

The channel is not affiliated with any law enforcement agency.

Our channel is compliant with YouTube's Fair Use Policy as we create a storyline and cut down several hours of long footage to a few minutes to bring out the most entertaining and educational parts, just like other channels such as Code Blue Cam, Real World Police, Active Police Cam, Blue Watch and Bodycam FIles.

The featured content is NOT intended to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved or to glorify violence in any way.
